Attune 0.0.6 introduces an integrated EPUB reader.

- Read in continuous scroll, single-page, or two-page layouts, with smooth page turns and saved reading progress.
- Navigate by table of contents, search within a book, and keep bookmarks.
- Adjust type, spacing, and reading theme to suit your preferences.

Packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon and Intel, Windows x64, and Linux x64. USB reader support remains experimental; physical-device behavior has not been validated on every platform. macOS downloads are ad-hoc signed and not notarized. See INSTALL.txt for installation requirements and signing details.
